pcp_pmcd_port.description: TCP port used by the Performance Metrics Collector Daemon (PMCD).

pcp_pmcd_start.description: Start the PMCD daemon at system boot.

pcp_pmcd_logdir.description: Directory where PMCD stores its runtime logs.

pcp_pmcd_log_max_size.description: Maximum size (KB) of a PMCD log file before rotation.

pcp_pmcd_log_history.description: Number of old PMCD log files to keep after rotation.

pcp_pmcd_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before declaring a client connection dead.

pcp_pmcd_allow.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses allowed to connect to PMCD. Empty list allows only local connections; use ['*'] to allow all (not recommended on public networks).

pcp_pmlogger_start.description: Start pmlogger (archive logging) at system boot.

pcp_pmlogger_logdir.description: Base directory for archived metric logs (used by pmlogger).

pcp_pmlogger_max_size.description: Maximum size (MB) per archive file before forced rotation.

pcp_pmie_start.description: Start the Performance Metrics Inference Engine (pmie) for rule-based alerting.

pcp_pmie_logdir.description: Directory for pmie logs and rule configuration.

pcp_pmwebd_start.description: Enable the pmwebd HTTP server for browser-based metric visualization.

pcp_pmwebd_port.description: HTTP port for the pmwebd service.

pcp_pmwebd_allow.description: List of allowed hosts for pmwebd. Empty = local only; ['*'] = all (use cautiously).

pcp_pmlogger_instances.description: List of custom pmlogger instances for collecting metrics from remote hosts.

name.description: Unique identifier for this pmlogger instance (used as suffix in config variables).

host.description: Host to monitor via this pmlogger instance.

logdir.description: Directory where this instance's logs will be stored.
